name: University of Southern Indiana
tuition_note: 2026-27 in-state (resident) tuition & fees $10,512 and on-campus housing $6,594 from official Cost of Attendance table at usi.edu/financial-aid/cost-of-attendance/2026-2027-cost-of-attendance (full-time undergrad, 30 credit hrs/yr). Housing is room only; meal plans billed separately (confirmed via usi.edu/housing/housing-options/housing-rates). Public school, in-state resident rate used.
